title: The 1979 revolution, the literacy crusade and Solentiname
goal: Tell what happened in Nicaragua after 1979 and say what continued in spite of difficulties, with a pesar de and pese a.
grammar: concession with a pesar de que and pese a (review)

sections.title: The 1979 revolution, the literacy crusade and Solentiname
body: In this lesson you read about the Sandinista revolution of 1979, the 1980 literacy crusade, the Contra war and the painters of Solentiname. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for saying that something went on in spite of a difficulty: *a pesar de* and *pese a*.

items: I can say that something continued in spite of a difficulty, with *a pesar de* and *pese a*.
I can tell what the literacy crusade of 1980 was.
I can explain who the painters of Solentiname were.
